description:
Checks a whole checkout or pricing page: finds the purchase button, the renewal disclosure, consent checkboxes and terms/cancel links, and evaluates them. Send html = the RENDERED page (after JavaScript; for React/Next pages, render it or paste the server output) — this is how to check a page before deploying.
Or send url to fetch a public page (live keys; test keys: your registered site's origin).
Static HTML cannot measure styling, so placement/styling passes come back as needs_review until a scan confirms; failures are real. When it fails, replacement holds verified drop-in markup.

as_of.description: Evaluate the law as of this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

html.description: Rendered checkout page HTML. Give html or url.

jurisdictions.description: Where the business sells: "all" (default) or state codes like ["US-CA","US-NY"] ("CA" works too). Federal law is always included.

plans.description: Multi-plan pricing page: EVERY plan it sells (price, interval, trial_days each). Each plan card is judged against its own plan; plan_replacements gives each plan its own markup for its own button.

cancel_timing.description: When a cancellation takes effect (default period_end).

cancel_url.description: https URL where subscribers cancel online (used in generated text).

interval.description: Billing interval: day, week, month or year.

intro_percent_off.description: Or the promo as % off (coupon percent_off).

trial_days.description: Free-trial days (0 or absent = no trial).

site.description: Your site_…: judge it as verify_task does (the site's Stripe-checked plans).

terms.description: The plan sold on the page. merchant_name / cancel_url alone are fine (no price compared).
